cases.purpose: Aux TTY matches a verified controlling PTY with standard descriptors open and closed.
cases.oracle: The kernel PTY slave pathname supplied by the independent fixture.
cases.comparison: Exact success marker and zero status after both cases.
cases.script:
[[ $(type -t ps) == builtin ]] || exit 97
for mode in open closed; do
  /usr/bin/python3 tty-fixture.py "$mode" & helper=$!
  trap 'kill "$helper" 2>/dev/null; wait "$helper" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
  for ((i=0; i<100; i++)); do [[ -s tty-info ]] && break; /usr/bin/sleep .05; done
  [[ -s tty-info ]] || exit 1
  read -r want_pid want_tty < tty-info
  found=0
  while read -r user pid cpu mem vsz rss tty rest; do
    if [[ $pid == "$want_pid" ]]; then [[ $tty == "$want_tty" ]] || exit 1; found=1; break; fi
  done < <(ps aux)
  [[ $found == 1 ]] || exit 1
  kill "$helper"; wait "$helper" || exit 1; trap - EXIT
  rm -f tty-info
done
printf 'tty resolution ok\n'
